quests.title: Walk the Trunk Road
quests.description: Captain Vesk holds the Forsaken Rear Guard at the border gate, and the Trunk Road is the only thing keeping the garrison connected to the Sepulcher. Nobody has walked its whole length since the first frost. Walk it to the Crossroads and tell him what you see.
quests.accept_text: South from the gate. Past the scout's post, past the Dead Field turning, down to the Crossroads. Keep your eyes open. I'd rather you kept them in your skull, too.
quests.turn_in_text: No ambush, no wreckage, no trouble but the usual. That is the best news I've had all week. Here, you've earned this.

quests.title: Thin the Woods
quests.description: The worgs have taken to the verge of the road, and the ghouls have taken to the worgs' leavings. Vesk would like both pushed back out of range of the Trunk Road, preferably in pieces.
quests.accept_text: Anywhere in the Silverpine woods. Worg Prowlers and Feral Ghouls. Make them think twice about the road.
quests.turn_in_text: A quieter road. Nobody will notice, which is exactly how it should be.

quests.title: Venom for the Vats
quests.description: Apothecary Pell has a theory that Silverpine spider venom, properly cut, can be used to slow the Plague's advance. Pell has a lot of theories. This one at least requires something killable. Bring six venom glands.
quests.accept_text: Silverpine Spiders in the woods. Cut the gland out cleanly. Don't squeeze. I cannot stress enough: don't squeeze.
quests.turn_in_text: Beautiful. Green, fresh, still faintly pulsing. If this works, the Dark Lady will hear my name. If it doesn't, you never met me.

objectives.label: Deliver the Rite of Quieting to Widow Marta, Olsen's Farthing

quests.accept_text: West along the Farthing road. The widow lives in the house nearest the dead orchard. Tell her to read it at dusk.
quests.turn_in_text: She said I'd send someone kind. I'd hoped she was joking. Thank you.

on_accept.name: Rite of Quieting
on_accept.description: A short rite on grave-wax paper. It smells of incense and old winter.

quests.title: The Three Spurs
quests.description: The Silverpine Scout watches the Trunk Road from the verge and has noticed fresh tracks on three of its spurs: the road east to the Dead Field, the path to the Shadowspring Pools, and the lane into Malden's Orchard. He wants eyes on the ends of all three.
quests.accept_text: Dead Field road, Pool path, Orchard lane. The tracks are the same on all three, and I do not like that.
quests.turn_in_text: Same boot on all three roads. Someone is scouting the Rear Guard's approaches. Vesk needs to hear this.

quests.title: The Hounds of the Farthing
quests.description: Gaffer Olsen kept hounds for forty years. Since the plague, they've kept him: hungry, rabid, and pacing the fence at night. The risen farmhands let them through the gate. He wants both dealt with, and is not above admitting he is afraid of his own dogs.
quests.accept_text: The fields around my farm. The hounds first. The farmhands - well. They were good lads once.
quests.turn_in_text: Quieter. Thank you. I'll fill the troughs again, I think, when I'm brave enough.

quests.title: Seed for Next Year

quests.accept_text: The farmhands still carry them. I don't know why. Habit, I suppose. Five sacks. I'll do the rest.
quests.turn_in_text: Good grain, if a little singed. I'll plant it at dawn. Somebody has to believe in dawn.

quests.accept_text: Raven Hill Cemetery. They climb out at dusk. Beat them back.
quests.turn_in_text: That will keep the shovel busy for another night, at least.

quests.accept_text: The creepers at the lower graves. Take the moss from the body, not the stones. The stones are still sacred.
quests.turn_in_text: Grey-green, thick with bone dust. It's feeding on them, and they're feeding on it. How very efficient.

quests.description: To find where the dead are climbing from, Dessa needs someone to stand at the three oldest crypts and listen. It is, she admits, a poor job. She has asked three other people. None came back with an answer.
quests.accept_text: Three crypts: east, north-west, south. Stand at each and count to ten. Listen for anything that isn't wind.
quests.turn_in_text: Scratching. Under all three. As if something's digging up from below. Oswin needs to hear this.

quests.accept_text: The Dead Field, east of the Trunk Road. Blighted crows. Aim for the eyes. They notice.
quests.turn_in_text: Fewer eyes on me, finally. I'm in your debt. Take a bow, if you like. I won't use it.

quests.accept_text: The woods around the gate. Treants, ghouls. Anything that shuffles toward the door.
quests.turn_in_text: The door stays closed to what should be kept out. Welcome inside, whenever you like.

quests.accept_text: Under the old trees. The shamblers wear bark. The wasps wear a grudge.
quests.turn_in_text: Fewer shamblers means more room for the trees to recover. Maybe.

quests.title: Eight Legs, Too Many
quests.description: Webhunter Corvane has tracked the spiders of the Skittering Dark for months, and the last month has been the worst: bigger, bolder, drifting toward the Trunk Road. He wants the breeding stock culled before they swarm.
quests.accept_text: East of the Crossroads, in the hollows. Keep to the road till you see the webs.
quests.turn_in_text: Fewer eyes in the dark. I'll almost sleep tonight.

quests.title: Egg Sacs of the Dark
quests.description: To end the swarm, Corvane needs the next generation. Egg sacs, carried by the skitterers themselves, and the only thing that makes the Widow's brood listen to anyone.
quests.accept_text: Take the sacs from their bodies. Don't puncture them. Carry them in silk, if you've got it.
quests.turn_in_text: Six. Sealed. Warm. I'll burn them at the road. Never let a spider make a nest next to a road.

quests.title: Longleg
quests.description: A spider the size of a cart prowls the Skittering Dark, and takes a hunter a week. The others call it Longleg. Corvane has lost three apprentices to it, and wants it ended.
quests.accept_text: Deep in the Dark, where the webs get thick. It moves faster than it should.
quests.turn_in_text: No more apprentices. Thank you.

quests.title: The Widow's Mouth
quests.description: Longleg's brood came from somewhere, and Corvane thinks he knows where: the cave at the end of the Skittering road, the Widow's Lair. He wants someone to stand at the mouth and tell him how deep the webs go.
quests.accept_text: East end of the Skittering road. Don't go in unprepared. And don't go in alone.
quests.turn_in_text: As I feared. Silk to the ceiling. I'll hold the rest of the road. You, if you've the stomach, can hold the cave.

quests.title: The Rear Guard's Reckoning
quests.description: Vesk has four reports on his desk: the Watchman is down, the Scarecrow-King is down, the Orchardkeeper is down, and Muckmaw is down. Whoever carried those four threads through the pines should stand at his desk and be thanked properly.
quests.accept_text: Come back to the gate. Walk through it. I'd like you to see what you've protected.
quests.turn_in_text: Four bosses, four reports, one hero. The Dark Lady's Rear Guard doesn't hand out praise. Take this instead.
